summary: Politecnico di Milano, Italy's leading university for engineering, architecture and design, offers Merit-Based International Scholarships to the strongest international applicants to its English-taught master's degrees. Every award waives tuition in full, and most of the 64 awards in the 2027-28 call add a yearly allowance of €2,500 to €10,000.
meta_description: Politecnico di Milano 2027-28 merit scholarships: a tuition waiver plus up to €10,000. Apply by 1 December 2026; scholarship form by 15 December.
covers: A full tuition-fee waiver for the first year of an English-taught MSc, renewable for the second; winners pay only an administrative fee of about €190.

Cash on top of the waiver in the 2027-28 call: Platinum €10,000 gross (10 awards) and Gold €8,000 (18) at the Milano Leonardo and Bovisa campuses; Gold Piacenza €5,000 (16) for Sustainable Architecture and Landscape Design, Landscape Architecture or Energy Engineering (RES); Bronze Piacenza €2,500 (10) for Mechanical Engineering (Mechatronics for Manufacturing).
Silver awards (10) at the Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza campuses: the tuition waiver alone.
Separately, students with limited family income can apply for the regional DSU scholarship, which is based on economic need rather than merit.
eligibility: International applicants to the first year of an English-taught Master of Science programme, starting in the first semester (September 2027).
You must submit your admission application and pay the application fee in the Early Bird period, 1 October to 1 December 2026.

Selection weighs your previous education and its match with the programme, your documents and the scholarship form; GPA and academic achievements (and a portfolio where requested) count most. The commission also considers geographic origin, gender balance and age, and gives priority to candidates from countries hit by military aggression or civil war.
Only applicants who are admitted, accept the admission outcome and upload a valid English certificate (by 4 March 2027) are considered.
how_to_apply: Choose up to two English-taught MSc programmes (1st and 2nd choice) and apply on Polimi's Online Services between 1 October and 1 December 2026, paying the €50 Early Bird fee.

Then fill in the separate scholarship form on Online Services (Benefits and Agreements → Economic benefits → Scholarships for International Master of Science Students a.y. 2027-2028) by 12:00 noon Italian time on 15 December 2026. No other way of applying is accepted.
Upload a valid English certificate by 4 March 2027 if you did not include it with your application.
Admission results come by the end of May 2027; scholarship outcomes are emailed three to four months after the application deadline.
Accept the award by paying the administrative fee (about €190) by the date in the award email, then enrol for 2027-28. Not enrolling cancels the scholarship.
watch_out: Applying in the Early Bird window is not enough on its own: the scholarship form must also be filed by 15 December 2026. Applicants in later admission rounds are not considered.
There are only 64 awards in the 2027-28 call across every English-taught MSc, so do not build your budget on winning one.

To keep the award in year two you need, by 10 August 2028, a sum of grades multiplied by ECTS credits of at least 1,000 points (Platinum) or 700 (Gold, Bronze and Silver), and you must stay in the same programme.
The merit scholarship cannot be combined with any other scholarship, Italian or foreign, except mobility grants. If you win another award you must choose one within ten days.

faq.q: When is the Politecnico di Milano scholarship deadline for 2027-28?
faq.a: There are two. Your admission application, with the €50 fee paid, must be in between 1 October and 1 December 2026, and the separate scholarship form by 12:00 noon Italian time on 15 December 2026. Your English certificate must be uploaded by 4 March 2027.

faq.q: How much are the merit scholarships worth?
faq.a: Every award waives tuition. On top of that, Platinum awards pay €10,000 gross a year and Gold €8,000 at the Milan campuses, while Gold Piacenza (€5,000) and Bronze Piacenza (€2,500) go to specific Piacenza programmes. Silver awards at the Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza campuses are the waiver alone.

faq.q: Can the scholarship be renewed for the second year?
faq.a: Yes, for 2028-29, if by 10 August 2028 your exam grades multiplied by their ECTS credits add up to at least 1,000 points for Platinum or 700 for the other awards, and you stay in the same programme. Extra credits and internships do not count. If it is not renewed, you pay tuition in year two.

faq.q: Can I combine it with a DSU grant or another scholarship?
faq.a: No. The merit scholarship is incompatible with any other scholarship from Politecnico di Milano or any other public or private body, Italian or foreign, apart from international mobility grants. If you win another award, you have ten days to tell the Financial Aid Unit which one you keep.
